records.name: Tree Gnome Village combat encounter and low-level bypasses
records.scope: Current encounter and preparation facts for Tree Gnome Village. This record does not set a route position, a combat-stat gate, a supply quantity, or a player-readiness conclusion.
records.formal_requirement: The quest guide lists the ability to defeat the level 112 Khazard warlord. It does not list a numeric combat-level requirement.

listed_inputs.logs: Six normal logs, or an axe obtainable from goblins in the maze.
listed_inputs.combat_and_food: Combat equipment and food are listed by the guide, with no fixed setup or quantity.

encounters.name: Khazard commanders
encounters.completion_boundary: The guide says they may be ignored or killed; no combat result, damage, supplies, or death outcome is modeled.

encounters.name: Khazard warlord
encounters.completion_boundary: Quest completion still requires the player to defeat the warlord and return the orbs. No win, damage, death, recovery, or supply use is inferred.

source_backed_tactics.summary: After starting the fight, the guide describes moving west until the warlord de-aggros near the large dead tree, then attacking with Ranged or Magic from outside its aggression range while preserving distance.
The guide describes melee flinching by stepping in and out of the warlord's walking range; it identifies a position beside the large skull south of the encounter as one option.

records.risk_and_execution_boundary: The current Wiki includes a recommended combat level and food, while community Ironman sources place the quest early only with a safespot or flinch technique. Positioning, spell or ammunition availability, food quantity, player execution, combat outcome, damage, death, and recovery remain player-specific observations.
